content: In principle, MLM and TLM can learn some implicit alignment information during model training. However, the alignment process in MLM is inefficient since the shared word pieces only account for a small proportion of the whole corpus, resulting in the difficulty of expanding the shared information to align the whole corpus. TLM also lacks effort in alignment between the source and target sentences since TLM concatenates the sentence pair into one sequence, making the explicit alignment between the source and target infeasible. BRLM fully utilizes the alignment information to obtain better word-level representation alignment between different languages, which better relieves the burden of the domain shift problem.
